decision: Cross-validate TensorLBM pluggable SCMP forcing schemes against clean reference
hypothesis: TensorLBM's velocity_shift, EDM, and Guo forcing implementations produce surface tension σ within 15% of reference (OSS-style) implementation; EDM and Guo should agree within 3%.
baseline: Clean numpy reference implementation using published formulas (Shan-Chen 1993, Kupershtokh 2004, Guo 2002)

changed: forcing scheme: velocity_shift vs edm vs guo

repetition_rationale: 4 radii (12, 16, 20, 24) for Laplace law fit; each run converges to steady state independently
environment: CPU, float64, numpy reference vs torch TensorLBM
stopping_rule: convergence when ρ_l and ρ_v drift < 1e-5 for 3 consecutive samples, or max 8000 steps
safety_limits: max 8000 steps per run, 4 radii × 3 schemes × 2 arms = 24 runs total
